create_pixtral_processor: create a PixtralProcessor instance with image_processor, tokenizer, and special image tokens for multimodal input
call_pixtral_processor: call PixtralProcessor with images and text to produce batched input_ids, attention_mask, and pixel_values
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for images with given sizes using patch_size and spatial_merge_size
check_model_input_names: get the combined model input names from tokenizer, image_processor, and image_sizes
configure_pixtral_processor_kwargs: configure PixtralProcessorKwargs with padding, return_mm_token_type_ids, and return_tensors settings
